title: What If a Meteorite Hit You? It Has Happened Once

scenes.text: What if a rock from space hit you? It has happened once.
On November 30, 1954, a meteorite weighing close to nine pounds crashed through a roof in Sylacauga, Alabama.
It tore through the ceiling and bounced off a radio console.
Then it struck Ann Hodges and left a massive bruise. She was hospitalized the next day.
She is the only person documented as injured by a meteorite strike.
In 2013 a blast over Chelyabinsk, Russia hurt people with its shock wave, not a direct hit. A direct hit is that rare.
